title: xanthoxalis polyantha
intro: Xanthoxalis polyantha, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Oxalis genus. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Xanthoxalis polyantha include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
